description: Install Arcade in Claude Desktop, Cowork, Claude Code, and Codex.

plugins.name: arcade
plugins.description: Your agent, every app you've connected. Ask in plain English for email, calendar, issues, and chat. Arcade finds and runs the right tool. Sign in once in the browser without handing your agent a key. In Claude Code and Copilot CLI, hooks locally classify prompts across sessions and send scoped usage events to Arcade's PostHog. No prompt text or app data is sent; set ARCADE_PLUGIN_TELEMETRY=0 to turn events off.
